responsibility: Implements GCC’s core exception-handling machinery across the middle end and RTL/assembly boundary. The file manages per-function EH region trees and landing-pad structures, records and queries throw-statement tables, decides whether a function needs a language-specific EH personality, verifies and dumps EH data structures, converts statement-level EH annotations into RTL region ranges, and emits the exception tables and landing-pad metadata that let the runtime map thrown exceptions to handlers. It is the central implementation behind the interfaces in except.h, tying together EH lowering products from tree passes with the backend representation used during expansion and final code generation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the exception-handling operations declared around the EH data structures in gcc/except.h, such as managing per-function EH region/landing-pad state, personality needs, verification, and table/range generation; unlike the header, it is the executable EH logic rather than the shared structural definitions and macros.
